# Decoded Ops
> Independent operations and technology consultancy for print, embroidery, workwear, and promotional merchandise businesses. Plain English. No jargon. Every recommendation scored against a written brief, including my own software.

## Consultancy
- [Clarity Check](https://decodedops.co.uk/small-business): Fixed-price remote diagnostic. £600.
- [Clarity Audit](https://decodedops.co.uk/clarity): Operational and technology audit. Priced to your scope. One day on site, a written plan within five working days. 3x Clarity Guarantee.
- [Deliver](https://decodedops.co.uk/deliver): Project delivery and vendor management. Priced to your scope; three-month minimum.
- [Transform](https://decodedops.co.uk/transform): Multi-workstream digital transformation. Priced to your scope; six-month minimum.
- [Retained](https://decodedops.co.uk/retained): Fractional CTO or COO. Priced to your scope; 12-month minimum.
- Consultancy (Clarity Audit, Deliver, Transform, Retained) is priced to the scope of the operation and quoted after a conversation; the Clarity Check (£600, fixed) is the only published price.
- [Pricing](https://decodedops.co.uk/pricing): The Clarity Check is the only fixed price. Everything else is quoted after a conversation.

## Software
I build software for the decorated-goods sector, to fill the gaps I kept finding where nothing off the shelf did the job: Decoded Works (the ERP for decorators, with the CRM as a module), Decoded Proof (artwork approval), Decoded Commerce (storefront and trade portal) and Decoded Catalogue (supplier feeds in, one clean catalogue out). The rule is off the shelf first: if an existing platform does the job, that is what I recommend, with no commission. If nothing does, including for a need specific to one client, I build it. Every option, my own software included, is scored against the same written brief. Software is quoted to your scope; buy outright or lease to own, and you own it at the end.

- [Free SOP Template](https://decodedops.co.uk/resources/sop-template): A free SOP template with a 7-step writing method, Process Register, and Improvement Log for decoration businesses.
- [ERP Selection Guide](https://decodedops.co.uk/resources/erp-selection-playbook): A plain-English guide to ERP for decorated goods: what it is, when you need it, how to choose.
- [Six Sigma for Decorated Goods](https://decodedops.co.uk/resources/six-sigma): Lean and Six Sigma applied to decoration businesses, not the factory playbook.
- [Artwork Approval Playbook](https://decodedops.co.uk/resources/artwork-approval-playbook): A 5-step workflow to take artwork approval from brief to sign-off in 24 hours.
- [The Decoded Method](https://decodedops.co.uk/resources/decoded-method): A three-layer process system: Process Register, one-page SOPs, and Improvement Log.
